svg.title: Which of the eight recurring patterns each part of the series teaches
svg.desc: A grid with the eight patterns as rows and parts 2 to 17 as columns. A filled cell is the part's main pattern, a dot is a pattern the part also uses. Scaling reads: main in 2 and 7. Scaling writes: main in 3, 11 and 12. Large blobs: 4 and 5. Contention: 3 and 6. Real-time updates: 8 and 17. Long-running tasks: 5, 13, 14 and 15. Multi-step processes: 16. Proximity and search: 9 and 10.
